seg.seg_note: STRUCTURE IN FORCE: two reportable segments 'Moody's Investors Service' (old MIS: four rating groups + Research, and ALL corporate expenses) and 'Moody's KMV' (MKMV). In this record mis_* = the OLD Moody's Investors Service segment (mis_lines = the four ratings lines plus 'Research revenue'; mis_ratings_total = ratings only) and ma_* = Moody's KMV (ma_lines = {'Moody's KMV'}). These are NOT comparable with the 2008+ MIS / MA segments: in January 2008 Research and MKMV were combined into Moody's Analytics, overhead/corporate costs were allocated by revenue split, an intersegment royalty (MIS revenue / MA expense) was introduced, and MIS lines were realigned (sovereign/sub-sovereign from FIG, infrastructure/utilities from CFG and project finance from SFG into new PPIF; REITs to SFG; Aug-2008 managed investments SFG->FIG). Reorganised (recast) figures are given in seg.legacy with labels starting 'Recast' and, for the prior year, in py. Inter-segment sales were 'insignificant' under the old structure (mis_interseg / elim null). Segment OI, D&A and restructuring: 10-K segment note (GAAP); no adjusted segment OI published. 2006 lines are as originally reported in the FY2006 release and FY2006 10-K Note 17 (identical). The FY2007 documents reclassified 2006 lines within old MIS (e.g. Public finance 85.9 -> 112.3, Research 258.7 -> 254.5, ratings 1,635.6 -> 1,639.8); those values are in legacy ('As reclassified ...'). The FY2007 release 'Summary Impact of Reorganization' gave a different first-cut 2006 recast (SF 883.6 / CF 377.6 / FI 222.1 / PPIF 156.5); the FY2007 10-K MD&A gave SF 883.6 / CF 335.9 / FI 222.1 / PPIF 198.2; the FY2008 10-K (after the Aug-2008 managed investments move) gives SF 872.6 / CF 335.9 / FI 233.1 / PPIF 198.2 (used in legacy 'Recast' and in 2007 py).

ngaap.notes: FY2006 release non-GAAP measures exclude: (1) the expensing of stock-based compensation (SFAS 123R; $77.1m in 2006), (2) the gain on sale of Moody's 99 Church Street building ($160.6m), and (3) adjustments for legacy income tax exposures ($2.4m tax benefit in 2006). Release: 'Beginning in 2007, stock-based compensation expense will no longer be excluded from non-GAAP results'. Published: Non-GAAP operating income 1,176.0, net income 704.8, basic EPS 2.48, diluted EPS 2.41. Release text also gives 'Excluding the gain, full year diluted earnings per share were $2.26' and OI excl. gain grew 17%. The FY2007 release later re-presented 2006 non-GAAP excluding only the building gain and legacy tax: OI 1,098.9, NI 657.4, diluted EPS 2.25 (use this for comparability with 2007 non-GAAP 2.50). EPS bridge per-share amounts are from release text ($0.32 gain, $0.17 SBC, $0.01 legacy tax); they sum to 2.42 vs published 2.41 (rounding, within 0.01). After-tax amounts of the gain and SBC are not published separately; the TAX row is computed.
